warnings.value: Tramadol has serotonergic activity in addition to weak opioid activity, so serotonin syndrome risk applies when combined with SSRIs, SNRIs or other serotonergic drugs — unlike classic opioids. Dependence/withdrawal potential exists with regular use.

overdoseSevereSigns.value: Respiratory depression and seizures are both possible in overdose — this is a medical emergency.

antidoteOrSupportive.value: Opioid-reversal agents may partially help the opioid component under emergency care, but do not reliably address the seizure risk — management is otherwise supportive.

clinicalPearls.value: Tramadol is atypical: its serotonergic activity means it can trigger serotonin syndrome in combination with antidepressants, which classic opioids do not.

counsellingPoints.value: Tell your pharmacist about any antidepressants you take. Avoid alcohol and other sedating medicines while on tramadol.

value.text: Breastfeeding mothers known to be ultra-rapid CYP2D6 metabolisers — higher morphine conversion can reach dangerous levels in the infant.

warnings.value: Codeine is a prodrug converted to morphine via CYP2D6; genetic variability in this enzyme means the same dose can under- or over-deliver active opioid between individuals, affecting both efficacy and respiratory-depression risk.

lessons.title: Why double-ups happen
lessons.body: Many combination cold products already contain paracetamol. Teaching patients to read the active ingredient list prevents accidental overdose — educational framing only.

lessons.title: Liver risk framing
lessons.body: Overdose can injure the liver. Materia does not publish numeric antidote protocols here — escalate to emergency care / Poisons Centre.
